candidates.note: Verified 24 Sep 2026 against Car Cave Scotland's authoritative seller-direct advert and every accessible exact seller image. The page is dated 04/09/2026 and remains explicitly FOR SALE at a fixed £44,995 for a 2010 Focus RS Mk2 in Frozen White, Lux 1, with only 5,699 miles and three previous owners. The seller states original specification, original alloys, V5, original book pack, service book with eight stamps, old MOTs and service receipts; the page gives its Bonnyrigg showroom address and live enquiry controls. All nine exact seller photographs were visually inspected in this run and none shows SOLD, RESERVED, DEPOSIT TAKEN or UNDER OFFER. Crucially, the exact interior photograph clearly shows the conventional manual gear lever and three pedals, clearing the mandatory manual-photo gate that had kept this car pending. UK location, qualifying year, fixed GBP price, current seller availability, specification and photo evidence now all pass the hard worker rules. This is also an exceptional low-mileage, original Mk2 rather than routine stock. The service chronology has long low-use gaps, so recommissioning/current-service position remains a buyer due-diligence point, not a verification failure.
